Lindsay Clancy's attorney seeks Trump pardon after mistrial

Following a mistrial in the case of Lindsay Clancy, her attorney has publicly requested a pardon from former President Donald Trump. The attorney also expressed willingness to negotiate a plea deal with the District Attorney's office and hopes they will revisit the case. Jurors in the trial have spoken out about the proceedings, with the foreperson stating that one juror admitted to having "reasonable doubt" but ultimately refused to acquit Clancy. Other jurors described issues with this holdout juror, calling them "arrogant."
